name: Caraka's path to release (Śārīrasthāna 1 and 5)

stages.name: lokadoṣadarśana; ācāryābhigamana
stages.gloss: seeing the faults of the world; approaching a teacher
stages.description: The seeker of release, seeing the world's faults, approaches a teacher and follows his instruction.

stages.name: satām upāsanā, vrata, niyama
stages.gloss: serving the good; vows, fasts, restraints; study of the dharma treatises
stages.description: Serving the good and avoiding the wicked; vows, fasts and restraints; truthful gentle speech; regarding all beings as oneself.

stages.name: sarvaparigrahatyāga
stages.description: Renunciation of possessions and the renunciant's life in solitude; bearing honour and insult, heat and cold.

stages.name: smṛtipūrvikā pravṛtti; indriyaniyamana
stages.description: Acting with mindfulness in sleeping, standing, walking, looking and eating; restraining attachment to objects; counting the body's parts by dhātus.

stages.name: yoga (manasaḥ ātmani sthiratā)
stages.gloss: the mind steady in the self
stages.description: Senses into mind, mind into self; when the mind is steady in the self pleasure and pain cease and mastery arises; the eight powers may appear.

stages.name: sattvaśuddhi
stages.description: The purified mind shines like a polished mirror, the unclouded sun, a lamp in a windless place.

stages.name: tattvasmṛti; satyā buddhi
stages.description: Seeing all that is caused as suffering, not one's own and impermanent; the understanding 'this is not I, this is not mine'; seeing the world in oneself and oneself in the world.

stages.name: caramasaṃnyāsa
stages.description: In the final renunciation all feelings with their roots cease entirely.

stages.name: mokṣa / brahmabhūta
stages.description: Separation from all conjunctions, non-return; the self, become brahman, has no mark — the tranquil, imperishable brahman, nirvāṇa.

notes: Bands are the interpretation layer; rests_on as in sources. Caraka presents these as simultaneous means flowing from tattvasmṛti rather than a strict sequence; the order follows the text's lists.

name: The path of the Raseśvara-darśana (body, yoga, liberation in life)

stages.name: gurusevā, dīkṣā
stages.description: The qualified disciple serves and pleases the guru, receives initiation and the secret teaching.

stages.name: rasa-saṃskāra; lohavedha
stages.gloss: processing of mercury; test on metal
stages.description: RESTRICTED — summarized only: mercury is purified and processed; its power is first tested on metal.

stages.name: dehavedha; piṇḍasthairya
stages.gloss: transformation of the body; stable body
stages.description: RESTRICTED — summarized only: the body is made stable, 'divine'.

stages.name: yogābhyāsa (rasa and pavana)
stages.gloss: yoga practice in the stable body
stages.description: Practice of yoga, with breath as the second 'discipline of action'; knowledge arises from practice.

stages.name: cinmaya jyotis
stages.gloss: the conscious light between the brows
stages.description: For some of meritorious vision the conscious light between the eyebrows opens: supreme bliss, free of conception.

stages.name: brahmatva ihaiva
stages.description: Placing the mind there and seeing the world as consciousness, bonds of karma cut, one attains brahmanhood here — liberation in life.

stages.name: jīvanmukta siddhas
stages.description: Freed of passion and hatred, same toward all, they live on in shining bodies, their work done.

notes: Restricted context: stages 2-3 are named only. Bands are the interpretation layer.
